dataset_id.identifier: The project datasets and their metadata will be made findable through deposition in trusted repositories that provide persistent identifiers and standard metadata. The primary repository will be Zenodo.

dataset.description: The dataset will be generated through the development and evaluation of osteochondral scaffolds within the project. It will capture data related to scaffold fabrication parameters, physicochemical and mechanical characterization, degradation and release behaviour, and in vitro biological evaluation, including biocompatibility and cell–material interaction.

format: The project will generate scaffold fabrication data, characterization data, degradation and release data, and in vitro biological evaluation data. These will be recorded in tabular and spreadsheet formats (CSV, XLSX), instrument-generated output files from analytical and characterization methods (TXT, CSV, PDF, and proprietary instrument formats), microscopy and other image files (TIF, PNG, JPG), and supporting documentation including protocols, reports, and statistical analyses (DOCX, PDF, TXT).

distribution.available_until: Where necessary, an embargo will be applied to datasets containing results that may support future scientific publications or potential intellectual property protection. Public access to such datasets will be temporarily restricted. The embargo period will be determined on a case-by-case basis and lifted by the responsible researcher in consultation with the host institution.

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan describes how research data generated in the project will be created, documented, stored, shared, and preserved. The project will generate interdisciplinary research data related to the development and evaluation of biomaterial scaffolds for osteochondral tissue regeneration, including scaffold fabrication, characterization, biological data, and supporting documentation.
